verses.text: There was a Pharisee named Nicodemus, one of the Jewish leaders.
He rolled up at night and told Jesus, “Rabbi, we know you’re a teacher sent from God. Nobody could do the signs you’re doing unless God was with him.”
Jesus answered, “I’m telling you straight: unless someone is born again, they can’t see God’s Kingdom.”
Nicodemus said, “How does an old man get born? He can’t climb back into his mom’s womb and start over, can he?”
Jesus answered, “I’m telling you straight: unless someone is born of water and the Spirit, they can’t enter God’s Kingdom.
A body gives birth to a body; the Spirit gives birth to spirit.
Don’t act shocked that I told you, ‘You all must be born again.’
The wind blows wherever it wants. You hear it, but you can’t tell where it came from or where it’s headed. That’s how it is with everyone born from the Spirit. 🌬️
Nicodemus asked him, “How can any of this happen?”
Jesus answered, “You’re Israel’s teacher, and this still isn’t clicking?
I’m telling you straight: we speak from what we know and testify to what we’ve seen, but you won’t accept our testimony.
If I tell you about earthly things and you don’t believe, how will you believe me when I tell you about heavenly things?
No one has gone up into heaven except the one who came down from heaven—the Son of Man, who is in heaven.
Just as Moses lifted up the snake in the wilderness, the Son of Man must be lifted up too,
so everyone who believes in him won’t perish, but will have eternal life.
God loved the world so much that he gave his one and only Son. Everyone who believes in him won’t perish but will have eternal life. ❤️
God didn’t send his Son into the world to judge it. He sent him so the world could be saved through him.
Whoever believes in him isn’t condemned. Whoever doesn’t believe has already been judged, because they haven’t trusted in the name of God’s one and only Son.
Here’s the judgment: light came into the world, but people chose darkness over light because their actions were evil.
Everyone doing evil hates the light and avoids it, so their actions don’t get exposed.
But whoever lives by the truth comes into the light, and it shows their actions were done through God.”
After that, Jesus and his disciples went into Judea. He stayed there with them and baptized people.
John was also baptizing at Aenon near Salim, because there was plenty of water there. People kept coming to get baptized.
This was before John was thrown into prison.
A debate broke out between John’s disciples and some Jews about purification.
They went to John and said, “Rabbi, that man who was with you across the Jordan—the one you testified about—is baptizing too, and everybody’s heading to him!”
John answered, “A person can receive nothing unless it’s given from heaven.
You heard me say it yourselves: ‘I am not the Christ. I was sent ahead of him.’
The bride belongs to the bridegroom. His friend stands nearby, listens in, and lights up when he hears the groom’s voice. That joy of mine is now complete.
He must grow greater; I must become less.”
“The one coming from above is over everybody. The one from earth belongs to earth and talks earthly talk. The one coming from heaven is over everybody.
He testifies to what he’s seen and heard, but no one accepts his testimony.
Whoever accepts his testimony puts their seal on this: God is true.
The one God sent speaks God’s words, because God gives the Spirit without limit.
The Father loves the Son and has put everything in his hands.
Whoever believes in the Son has eternal life. Whoever disobeys the Son won’t see life; God’s anger remains on them.”
